post.ctaTitle: Ready to put a price on it?
post.ctaBody: Create your store free and add your first product in minutes.

article.lede: Pricing is the decision most new sellers get wrong, usually by charging too little. A low price feels safe, but it leaves no room for shipping surprises, returns or a discount code when you need one. Here's a simple way to get it right.
article.s1Body: Add up everything it takes to get one unit ready to ship: materials or wholesale price, packaging, labels and any printing. If you make the product yourself, include your time.
article.s2: 2. Add the costs you don't see
s2List: Shipping, if you offer free delivery.
Platform fee: a flat 5 EGP per order on Tallaby.
A small buffer for returns and damaged items.
article.s3: 3. Choose a margin you can live with
article.s3Body: For most handmade and small-batch goods, a margin between 50% and 100% on top of cost leaves room to grow. Lower margins can work for high-volume items, but only if your orders really are high volume.
article.quote: If a 10% discount would make you lose money, your price is too low.
article.s4Body: Look at three or four brands selling something similar. You don't need to be the cheapest; you need to be clearly worth it. Then round to a clean number: 449 or 450 reads better than 437.
article.tip: Tip: test a price for two weeks before changing it. Small samples move around a lot.
article.toolBody: Enter your numbers. The suggested price already covers the 5 EGP Tallaby fee.

about.title: Every brand in Egypt deserves a store with its <u>own name</u> on it.
about.lead: We build the tools that let small brands sell online like big ones: their own link, their own look, their own customers. No code, no monthly fee.
about.story: Most Egyptian brands start on Instagram and WhatsApp. Orders live in DMs, stock lives in a notebook, and the brand lives on someone else's platform. We started Tallaby to give them a home of their own.
about.story1: Tallaby began as a marketplace connecting shoppers with independent vendors across Egypt. Talking to those vendors every day, we heard the same request: help us sell under our own name.
about.story2: So we built a store builder that fits how they actually work: Arabic first, mobile first, cash and online payments, local shipping, and a price that only kicks in when they make sales.
about.p1Body: Your store carries your name, your colors and your link. Tallaby stays in the background.
about.p2Body: No subscriptions, no setup fees. If you don't sell, you don't pay.
about.p3Body: Arabic interface, EGP pricing, local payment methods and couriers, support on WhatsApp.
about.p4Body: If a feature needs a tutorial, we redesign it. Running a store should feel like using your phone.
about.hiringBody: Help us put more Egyptian brands online.

items.q: How long does it take to set up a store?
items.a: Signup takes under a minute: your store link, email and password, or Google. After that you pick a template, add products and publish whenever you're ready.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Everything from design to publishing is visual. If you can use a phone, you can run your store.

items.q: Can I move products from another store?
items.a: Yes. Upload a CSV of your products from the Products page, or ask support to help with the move.

items.q: How much does Tallaby cost?
items.a: The plan is free. We charge a flat 5 EGP per successful order, with no percentage of the order value and no monthly fee.

items.q: Does the fee change with order value?
items.a: No. A 150 EGP order and a 5,000 EGP order both cost 5 EGP. Cancelled and returned orders aren't charged.

items.q: Is there a limit on products or orders?
items.a: No. The free plan includes unlimited products, orders and visitors.

items.q: How do my customers pay?
items.a: You choose which payment options to enable from your dashboard, such as cards, mobile wallets and cash on delivery. Every store also gets a direct online payment link.

items.q: When do I get paid?
items.a: Payouts go to your bank account or wallet on the schedule you choose in Finance, after fees are deducted.

items.q: Are payment fees part of the 5 EGP?
items.a: No. Payment processing fees are separate from the 5 EGP, depend on the method, and are shown before you enable it.

items.q: Who ships my orders?
items.a: You can ship yourself or use the couriers connected to Tallaby from your dashboard.

items.q: How is shipping priced?
items.a: Per shipment, by destination and weight. The price is shown before you confirm.

items.q: How do returns work?
items.a: You set your return policy in Settings and customers request returns from the order page. Returned orders aren't charged commission.

items.q: Can I change templates after publishing?
items.a: Yes, anytime. Your products, orders and settings stay the same.

items.q: Does my store support Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. Every template supports both directions, and you can add product details in both languages.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Your store starts on a free address like yourbrand.tallaby.com. You can connect a domain you own from Settings, then update its DNS records.

items.q: Can I change my store link?
items.a: Yes, from Settings, if the new link is available. The old link redirects to the new one for 30 days.

sections.title: Accepting these terms
paragraphs: By creating an account or using Tallaby, you agree to these terms. If you use Tallaby on behalf of a business, you confirm you can accept them for that business.
You must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a binding contract under Egyptian law.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: Keep your login details private and tell us right away if you think someone else has accessed your account. You're responsible for activity under your account.
list: Use accurate information when signing up.
One person or business per account.
Store links must not impersonate another brand.

sections.title: Your store and content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of everything you upload: product photos, descriptions, logos and brand assets. You give Tallaby permission to host and display that content so your store can work.
sections.note: We never sell your products or content to anyone else.

sections.title: Selling rules
paragraphs: You're responsible for the products you sell, their descriptions, pricing, stock and delivery to your customers. You may not sell:
list: Items that are illegal in Egypt.
Counterfeit goods or items that infringe someone's rights.
Weapons, drugs, or regulated medicines without a licence.

sections.title: Fees and payouts
paragraphs: Tallaby is free to use. We charge a flat 5 EGP for each successful order, regardless of the order value. We don't take a percentage of your sales and there is no monthly subscription. Products, orders and visitors are unlimited.
Payment processing and shipping are charged separately and shown before you enable or confirm them. Fees are deducted from your payouts, and every deduction is listed in your dashboard.

sections.title: Orders and customers
paragraphs: Each sale is a contract between you and your customer. You set your own return and refund policy, and it must be visible on your store. Tallaby may help resolve disputes but is not a party to the sale.

sections.title: Closing or suspending a store
paragraphs: You can close your store at any time from Settings. We may suspend a store that breaks these terms, after notifying you where possible. Outstanding payouts are settled after any open orders are completed.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: We work hard to keep Tallaby available and secure, but we provide the service as is. To the extent the law allows, Tallaby isn't liable for indirect losses such as lost profits.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If we change these terms in a meaningful way, we'll tell you by email or in your dashboard at least 14 days before the change applies. These terms are governed by the laws of Egypt.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Tallaby operates the store builder at tallaby.com and the stores hosted on it. This policy covers sellers who use Tallaby and shoppers who buy from Tallaby stores.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: We only collect what we need to run your store and process orders.

sections.title: How we use it
list: Running your store, checkout and payouts.
Preventing fraud and keeping accounts secure.
Sending service messages about orders, fees and changes.
Marketing emails, only if you opt in. You can unsubscribe anytime.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share data only with service providers who help us run Tallaby, such as payment processors, couriers and hosting providers, and only what they need to do that job. We may also share data if the law requires it.
sections.note: Shopper data belongs to the seller's store. Sellers can use it to fulfil orders, not to resell it.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart and language. Analytics cookies are optional and off until you accept them.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is limited to staff who need it, and card details are handled by certified payment providers. Tallaby never stores full card numbers.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: To use any of your rights or ask a question, email us. We reply within 30 days.
